source.quote: Cayin's own page for the iDAC-8, read 2026-11-25. The page is German. Specification rows: « DAC-Chipset » « AK4191 Digital, 2x AK4499EX (Mono) »; « Eingaenge » « i2S, USB, Coaxail (RCA & BNC), AES/EBU, Optical » - the misspelling « Coaxail » is the page's; « Roehrenbestueckung » « 6H6b-B 2x ». Description: « Der iDAC-8 steht mit einem Tandem aus AK4191EQ - AK4499EXEQ Wandler Chips und einer 6H6b-B Roehrenschaltung ». On filters: « Unabhaengig davon, wie gut die 64-Bit-Digitalfilter [...] des AK4191EQ funktionieren » - the chip's filters mentioned, with no mode list and no switch. NO sample rate and NO bit depth appear anywhere on the page, for the device or for any input. The word NOS does not appear.

facts.chip: « AK4191 Digital, 2x AK4499EX (Mono) » (Asahi Kasei) - a digital front-end part and two mono converters, the arrangement SPL and Aurender also use. The « 6H6b-B 2x » are output tubes.

_verification_des_conditions_faite: cayin.com has no terms-of-use page; its « Rechtliches » menu offers an Impressum, a cookie policy, AGB, payment, shipping, withdrawal and data protection. The AGB WAS READ - they are sales terms for the webshop - and carry no clause on copying, reproducing or extracting site content. The footer reads « Copyright: Cayin Audio Distribution GmbH », the ordinary notice. Worth stating: HiBy, read the same hour, forbids it outright.
_six_entrees_nommees_et_pas_un_seul_chif: « i2S, USB, Coaxail (RCA & BNC), AES/EBU, Optical » and not one rate, bit depth or DSD figure on the whole page - while the maker's own CS-100DAC, same site, same template, rates its USB and I2S precisely. A level-1 record on a brand that can clearly do better, which is a reason to ask Cayin rather than to guess from the sibling.
_les_filtres_sont_ceux_de_la_puce_et_le_: « wie gut die 64-Bit-Digitalfilter [...] des AK4191EQ funktionieren ». The filters belong to the AK4191, the maker praises them, and never says whether the owner can choose among them. No device_settings entry: a filter that exists inside a chip is not a setting until someone can reach it.
